scope: Simulation. Cost tables are measured on an AMD R9700 (gfx1201) under Gate B-AMD; no GPU runs in this verifier. Nothing here is a hardware claim.

c1_byte_identical_replay.note: separate processes, so an unsorted set would show up
c1_byte_identical_replay.criterion: 同 seed 仿真结果逐字节可复现

c2_canonical_accounting.definition: charged quota-seconds vs unit-seconds granted, including units held through a round no step completed in
c2_canonical_accounting.criterion: canonical service 对 SM quota 的记账差异小于 1%

c3_backlogged_jain.trace: two tenants, equal demand, all queued at t=0
c3_backlogged_jain.note: unserved tenants are seeded at zero, so starvation cannot score 1.0 by absence
c3_backlogged_jain.criterion: backlogged workload 的 Jain index 不低于 0.98

c4_service_lag.definition: peak over rounds of the worst deviation from an equal share among backlogged tenants, in full-die quanta; sampled per round because the end-of-run gap is zero for a policy that was never fair
c4_service_lag.exemption: overrides are detected by the simulator from the predictions the policy saw, not self-reported
c4_service_lag.criterion: 无 deadline override 时 service lag 不超过两个最大 quantum

c5_no_avoidable_miss.feasibility_witness: preemptive EDF, whole die, step-granular preemption
c5_no_avoidable_miss.note: deadlines derived from what EDF achieved, not from nominal per-request cost, which ignores the queue
c5_no_avoidable_miss.criterion: 构造的可行 deadline trace 中不存在可避免 miss

c6_safe_degradation.definition: safe = accounting still exact (it is measured, not predicted), lag still bounded, utilisation within 5% of the exact-predictor run
c6_safe_degradation.criterion: predictor error {±5%,±10%,±20%} 下能够安全降级

c7_algorithm_freeze.output: PASS: 14 functions, 3 tables and 4 behavioural digests match the freeze
c7_algorithm_freeze.criterion: 算法、公式和 action 顺序冻结，修改须写 decision log
